view.scene_description: The image depicts a modern library or bookstore interior with a large, illuminated cylindrical bookshelf in the center. The cylindrical shelf is composed of multiple circular levels, each filled with books. The shelves are illuminated from within, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The floor is tiled, and there are several orange chairs arranged around small tables where people are seated, likely reading or studying. A young man wearing glasses and a white jacket stands near the right edge of the image, looking towards the camera. In the background, there are wooden archways leading to more seating areas, and a blue wall with a glass panel on the right side. The overall scene suggests a comfortable and well-lit environment for reading and learning.

objects.label: cylindrical bookshelf
objects.observation: The central feature of the image is a large, illuminated cylindrical bookshelf made up of multiple circular levels, each filled with books. The shelves are illuminated from within, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The cylindrical shelf is approximately 3 meters tall and occupies the center of the image.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Several orange chairs are arranged around small tables where people are seated, likely reading or studying. The chairs are positioned in a semi-circle around the tables, and their bright color contrasts with the warm tones of the bookshelf and the wooden archways in the background.

objects.label: young man with glasses
objects.observation: A young man wearing glasses and a white jacket stands near the right edge of the image, looking towards the camera. He appears to be observing the surroundings or possibly waiting for someone. His presence adds a human element to the scene, suggesting that this is a public space where people come to read, study, or socialize.

objects.label: wooden archways
objects.observation: In the background, there are wooden archways leading to more seating areas. These archways have a rustic appearance and provide a contrast to the modern design of the cylindrical bookshelf. They add depth to the image and suggest that this is a larger space with multiple sections.

objects.label: blue wall with glass panel
objects.observation: On the right side of the image, there is a blue wall with a glass panel. This wall adds a pop of color to the scene and provides a glimpse into another area of the building. The glass panel allows natural light to filter into the space, enhancing the overall ambiance.

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000023", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
